module: Editor tool "Vehicle Detail Viewer" (menu Window > Vehicles, also F11 > Window > Experimental). Opens imgui windows that display orthographic views of the player vehicle (Left, Right, Top, Bottom, Front, Back) rendered into a texture via RenderViewManagerInstance, with zoom, drag panning and double-click reset. Each view is fitted to the vehicle's oriented bounding box (getSpawnWorldOOBB). Layouts can be saved in /settings/vehicleDetails/*.vehicleDetailSetting.json (default: default.vehicleDetailSetting.json).
notes: No rendering takes place until the user has chosen the menu entry (detailViewerActive); when the last window is closed, all views are destroyed.
The far clip plane is set to 10 m (farClip) and the scale to 200 pixels per meter.
The views are recreated every time a vehicle spawns (onVehicleSpawned sets `views` to nil); only the player vehicle is displayed.
onSerialize destroys the render views and converts the imgui pointers to plain data before Lua reload; onDeserialized converts them back.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Adds the 'Vehicle Detail Viewer' menu entry (Vehicles group) which activates the tool.

onPreRender.desc: Called every frame before rendering: creates the view models for the player vehicle, loads the default layout, draws each view window and triggers the orthographic rendering; cleans up when everything is closed.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Called when a vehicle spawns: forgets the views to recreate them with the new vehicle.

onSerialize.desc: Before Lua reload: destroys the render views and returns {views} without the non-serializable objects.

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the views and recreates the windowOpen imgui pointers. Also used to load a layout file.

data.desc: Table from onSerialize or content of the layout file.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called when the extension is loaded: displays a message and lists the available layout files.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Called on unload: destroys the remaining render views.
